metadata.description: Visual aptitude / CAT question solver skill for Claude Code and Antigravity CLI

plugins.name: cat-aptitude
plugins.description: Solves aptitude and competitive-exam questions supplied as screenshots: bar/line/pie/stacked/dual-axis DI, caselets, LR and DILR sets, Venn min-max, geometry figures, Data Sufficiency and quant. Optimizes for correctness by transcribing the visual, validating it, and computing in Python.
